adam-adae-death.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADAE
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
input:
  AE: {path: input/ae.csv, types: {ASTDT: date}}
  DM: {path: input/dm.csv, types: {DTHDT: date}}
base: AE

output:
  path: adae.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ, AEDECOD, ASTDT, DTHFL, DTHCAUS, DTHDT]

intermediates:
  - id: DEATHEV
    dataset: AE
    key: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
    filter: "AE.AEOUT = 'FATAL'"
    order_by: [AE.ASTDT, AE.AESEQ]
    keep: last
    no_match: null

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: AE.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: AE.USUBJID

  - name: AESEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: AE.AESEQ

  - name: AEDECOD
    type: str
    label: Dictionary-Derived Term
    derivation: AE.AEDECOD

  - name: ASTDT
    type: date
    label: Analysis Start Date
    derivation: AE.ASTDT

  # The subject's fatal event: the latest by start date, ties broken by
  # the highest sequence number.
  - name: DTHAESEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number of the Fatal Event
    derivation: DEATHEV.AESEQ

  - name: DTHCAUS
    type: str
    label: Cause of Death
    derivation: DEATHEV.AEDECOD

  # The fatal event's start date wins; demographics fills in otherwise.
  - name: DTHDT
    type: date
    label: Date of Death
    derivation:
      first_available:
        sources: [DEATHEV.ASTDT, DM.DTHDT]

  - name: DTHFL
    type: str
    label: Death Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "DTHDT IS NOT NULL"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 10
      max: 10
  - assert:
      id: fatal-event-carries-its-own-cause
      when: "AESEQ = DTHAESEQ"
      require: "DTHCAUS = AEDECOD AND DTHDT = ASTDT"
  - assert:
      id: no-cause-without-a-fatal-event
      when: "DTHCAUS IS NOT NULL"
      require: "DTHDT IS NOT NULL"
  - assert:
      id: death-date-marks-the-subject
      when: "DTHDT IS NOT NULL"
      require: "DTHFL = 'Y'"

adam-adae-occurrence-flags.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADAE
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
input:
  ADAE_RAW: {path: input/adae_raw.csv, types: {ASTDT: date}}

output:
  path: adae.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ, AEBODSYS, AEDECOD, ASTDT, TRTEMFL, AOCCFL,
            AOCCSFL, AOCCPFL]

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: ADAE_RAW.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: ADAE_RAW.USUBJID

  - name: AESEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: ADAE_RAW.AESEQ

  - name: AEBODSYS
    type: str
    label: Body System or Organ Class
    derivation: ADAE_RAW.AEBODSYS

  - name: AEDECOD
    type: str
    label: Dictionary-Derived Term
    derivation: ADAE_RAW.AEDECOD

  - name: ASTDT
    type: date
    label: Analysis Start Date
    derivation: ADAE_RAW.ASTDT

  - name: TRTEMFL
    type: str
    label: Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag
    derivation: ADAE_RAW.TRTEMFL
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

  # Number each subject's treatment-emergent events (earliest first, AESEQ
  # breaking same-day ties) at three levels; each flag below marks number 1.
  - name: AOCCSEQ
    type: int
    label: Subject Occurrence Sequence Number
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
          order_by: [ASTDT, AESEQ]
          filter: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"

  - name: AOCCSSEQ
    type: int
    label: Body System Occurrence Sequence Number
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AEBODSYS]
          order_by: [ASTDT, AESEQ]
          filter: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"

  - name: AOCCPSEQ
    type: int
    label: Preferred Term Occurrence Sequence Number
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AEBODSYS, AEDECOD]
          order_by: [ASTDT, AESEQ]
          filter: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"

  - name: AOCCFL
    type: str
    label: 1st Occurrence within Subject Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "AOCCSEQ = 1"

  - name: AOCCSFL
    type: str
    label: 1st Occurrence of SOC Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "AOCCSSEQ = 1"

  - name: AOCCPFL
    type: str
    label: 1st Occurrence of Preferred Term Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "AOCCPSEQ = 1"

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 10
      max: 10
  - assert:
      id: occurrence-flag-requires-treatment-emergence
      when: "AOCCFL = 'Y' OR AOCCSFL = 'Y' OR AOCCPFL = 'Y'"
      require: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"

  ADSL: {path: input/adsl.csv, types: {TRTSDTM: datetime}}
base: AE

output:
  path: adae.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ, AETERM, ASTDTM, TRTSDTM, TRTEMFL, AOCCFL]

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: AE.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: AE.USUBJID

  - name: AESEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: AE.AESEQ

  - name: AETERM
    type: str
    label: Reported Term for the Adverse Event
    derivation: AE.AETERM

  - name: ASTDTM
    type: datetime
    label: Analysis Start Date/Time
    derivation: AE.AESTDTC

  - name: TRTSDTM
    type: datetime
    label: Datetime of First Exposure to Treatment
    derivation: ADSL.TRTSDTM

  # A comparison with a missing moment is unknown, never true, so the flag
  # stays empty when either the onset or the first exposure is missing.
  - name: TRTEMFL
    type: str
    label: Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "ASTDTM >= TRTSDTM"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

  - name: AOCCSEQ
    type: int
    label: Subject Occurrence Sequence Number
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
          order_by: [ASTDTM, AESEQ]
          filter: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"

  - name: AOCCFL
    type: str
    label: First Occurrence Within Subject Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "AOCCSEQ = 1"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 7
      max: 7
  - assert:
      id: treatment-emergent-onset-is-not-before-first-dose
      when: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"
      require: "ASTDTM >= TRTSDTM"
  - assert:
      id: occurrence-flag-requires-treatment-emergence
      when: "AOCCFL = 'Y'"
      require: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"

adam-adae-partial-dates.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADAE
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
input:
  AE: input/ae.csv
  ADSL: {path: input/adsl.csv, types: {TRTSDT: date}}
base: AE

output:
  path: adae.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ, AETERM, AESTDTC, ASTDT, ASTDTC, ASTDTF,
            TRTSDT, TRTEMFL]

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: AE.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: AE.USUBJID

  - name: AESEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: AE.AESEQ

  - name: AETERM
    type: str
    label: Reported Term for the Adverse Event
    derivation: AE.AETERM

  - name: AESTDTC
    type: str
    label: Start Date/Time of Adverse Event
    derivation: AE.AESTDTC

  - name: TRTSDT
    type: date
    label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
    derivation: ADSL.TRTSDT

  # Complete a year-and-month start to the 15th, never before first
  # exposure. A year alone, non-date text, or nothing gives no date.
  # (Month precision is the minimum accepted, so no month is ever
  # supplied, and none is written.)
  - name: ASTDT
    type: date
    label: Analysis Start Date
    derivation:
      date_impute:
        source: AESTDTC
        day: 15
        minimum_source_precision: month
        not_before: TRTSDT
        missing: null   # handlers are explicit: an omitted one is fatal
        invalid: null

  - name: ASTDTC
    type: str
    label: Analysis Start Date (C)
    derivation: ASTDT

  - name: ASTDTPR
    type: str
    label: Analysis Start Date Precision
    derivation:
      date_precision:
        source: ASTDT
        missing: null

  # M means the collected start carried a year and month, so the day was
  # supplied.
  - name: ASTDTF
    type: str
    label: Analysis Start Date Imputation Flag
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "ASTDTPR = 'M'"
          then: {literal: "D"}
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: ["D"]

  - name: TRTEMFL
    type: str
    label: Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "ASTDT >= TRTSDT"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 13
      max: 13
  - all_or_none:
      id: analysis-date-completeness
      columns: [ASTDTC, ASTDT]
  - assert:
      id: imputation-flag-requires-an-analysis-date
      when: "ASTDTF IS NOT NULL"
      require: "ASTDT IS NOT NULL"
  - assert:
      id: supplied-day-never-precedes-treatment-start
      when: "ASTDTF = 'D'"
      require: "TRTSDT IS NULL OR ASTDT >= TRTSDT"
  - assert:
      id: treatment-emergent-event-has-an-analysis-date
      when: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"
      require: "ASTDT IS NOT NULL AND ASTDT >= TRTSDT"

adam-adae-post-index.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADAE
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
input:
  AE:
    path: input/ae.csv
    types: {AESEQ: int, AESTDTC: date}

output:
  path: adae.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ, AEDECOD, ASTDT, AFTIDXFL]

intermediates:
  # Each subject's index event: the first event carrying the designated
  # index term (in this fixture, COVID-19) -- earliest start, then
  # lowest AESEQ.
  - id: FIRSTIDX
    dataset: AE
    key: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
    filter: "AE.AEDECOD = 'COVID-19'"
    order_by: [AE.AESTDTC, AE.AESEQ]
    keep: first
    no_match: null

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: AE.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: AE.USUBJID

  - name: AESEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: AE.AESEQ

  - name: AEDECOD
    type: str
    label: Dictionary-Derived Term
    derivation: AE.AEDECOD

  - name: ASTDT
    type: date
    label: Analysis Start Date
    derivation: AE.AESTDTC

  # Strictly after the subject's index event in (start date, AESEQ) order.
  # A missing start compares as unknown, so the flag stays empty.
  - name: AFTIDXFL
    type: str
    label: After Index Event Flag
    derivation:
      flag: >-
            ASTDT > FIRSTIDX.AESTDTC OR
            (ASTDT = FIRSTIDX.AESTDTC AND AESEQ > FIRSTIDX.AESEQ)

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 11
      max: 11

occurrences.payload: ASTDT > FIRSTIDX.AESTDTC OR (ASTDT = FIRSTIDX.AESTDTC AND AESEQ > FIRSTIDX.AESEQ)

adam-adae-worsening-emergence.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADAE
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
input:
  AE: {path: input/ae.csv, types: {AESTDTC: datetime, AETOXGR: int}}
  ADSL: {path: input/adsl.csv, types: {TRTSDTM: datetime}}
base: AE

output:
  path: adae.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ, AEDECOD, ASTDTM, TRTSDTM, AESEV,
            AETOXGR, TRTEMFL]

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: AE.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: AE.USUBJID

  - name: AESEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: AE.AESEQ

  - name: AEDECOD
    type: str
    label: Dictionary-Derived Term
    derivation: AE.AEDECOD

  - name: ASTDTM
    type: datetime
    label: Analysis Start Date/Time
    derivation: AE.AESTDTC

  - name: TRTSDTM
    type: datetime
    label: Datetime of First Exposure to Treatment
    derivation: ADSL.TRTSDTM

  - name: AESEV
    type: str
    label: Severity/Intensity
    derivation: AE.AESEV
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [MILD, MODERATE, SEVERE]

  - name: AETOXGR
    type: int
    label: Standard Toxicity Grade
    derivation: AE.AETOXGR
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

  # Numeric rank of the collected severity, so a later episode can be
  # compared with an earlier one for the same term. Not in the output.
  - name: AESEVN
    type: int
    label: Severity/Intensity (N)
    derivation:
      mapping:
        source: AESEV
        dict:
          MILD: 1
          MODERATE: 2
          SEVERE: 3
        missing: null

  # Highest severity reached at or after first exposure, within the
  # subject and term. A comparison with a missing moment is unknown,
  # so rows with no onset or no exposure never contribute. Not in
  # the output.
  - name: POSTMAX
    type: int
    label: Maximum Post-Treatment Severity (N)
    derivation:
      aggregate:
        filter: "ASTDTM >= TRTSDTM"
        group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AEDECOD]
        expr: "MAX(AESEVN)"

  # Highest toxicity grade reached at or after first exposure,
  # within the subject and term. Rows with no onset, no grade, or
  # no exposure never contribute. Not in the output.
  - name: POSTMAXG
    type: int
    label: Maximum Post-Treatment Toxicity Grade
    derivation:
      aggregate:
        filter: "ASTDTM >= TRTSDTM"
        group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AEDECOD]
        expr: "MAX(AETOXGR)"

  # A comparison with a missing value is unknown, never true, so the
  # flag stays empty when the onset or the first exposure is missing,
  # and for an earlier event when neither the severity nor the grade
  # rises later.
  - name: TRTEMFL
    type: str
    label: Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "ASTDTM >= TRTSDTM OR (ASTDTM < TRTSDTM AND
        (AESEVN < POSTMAX OR AETOXGR < POSTMAXG))"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 18
      max: 18
  - assert:
      id: treatment-emergent-event-has-known-onset-and-exposure
      when: "TRTEMFL = 'Y'"
      require: "ASTDTM IS NOT NULL AND TRTSDTM IS NOT NULL"

occurrences.payload: ASTDTM >= TRTSDTM OR (ASTDTM < TRTSDTM AND (AESEVN < POSTMAX OR AETOXGR < POSTMAXG))

    derivation:
      flag: "AWSRNK = 1"

      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AESEQ]

  - assert:

    verifications:

    verifications:

    verifications:

  - row_count:

  - row_count:

      filter: "AOCCFL = 'Y'"
      min: 0
      max: 1

adam-adlb-closest-visit.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADLB
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, LBSEQ]
input:
  ADLB_RAW: {path: input/adlb_raw.csv, types: {ADT: date}}

output:
  path: adlb.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, LBSEQ, ADT, ADY, AVAL, AVISIT, AWTARGET,
            ADIST, ANL01FL]

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: ADLB_RAW.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: ADLB_RAW.USUBJID

  - name: PARAMCD
    type: str
    label: Parameter Code
    derivation: ADLB_RAW.PARAMCD

  - name: LBSEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: ADLB_RAW.LBSEQ

  - name: ADT
    type: date
    label: Analysis Date
    derivation: ADLB_RAW.ADT

  - name: ADY
    type: int
    label: Analysis Relative Day
    derivation: ADLB_RAW.ADY

  - name: AVAL
    type: float
    label: Analysis Value
    derivation: ADLB_RAW.AVAL

  # One analysis window, study days 8 to 22 around target day 15. A record
  # outside it, or with no study day, gets no visit, target, or distance.
  - name: AVISIT
    type: str
    label: Analysis Visit
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "ADY BETWEEN 8 AND 22"
          then: {literal: WEEK 2}
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [WEEK 2]

  - name: AWTARGET
    type: int
    label: Analysis Window Target
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "AVISIT IS NOT NULL"
          then: {literal: 15}

  - name: ADIST
    type: float
    label: Analysis Day Distance from Target
    derivation:
      compute:
        expr: "ABS(ADY - AWTARGET)"
    verifications:
      range:
        min: 0

  # Within each subject, parameter, and visit: closest to the target first,
  # then the later study day, then the lower sequence number. ANL01FL marks
  # rank 1.
  - name: ARNK
    type: int
    label: Analysis Rank
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, AVISIT]
          order_by:
            - ADIST
            - {variable: ADY, direction: desc}
            - LBSEQ
          filter: "AVISIT IS NOT NULL"

  - name: ANL01FL
    type: str
    label: Analysis Record Flag 01
    derivation:
      flag: "ARNK = 1"

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, LBSEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 11
      max: 11
  - all_or_none:
      id: window-derivation-completeness
      columns: [AVISIT, AWTARGET, ADIST]
  - assert:
      id: analysis-record-is-inside-window
      when: "ANL01FL = 'Y'"
      require: "ADY BETWEEN 8 AND 22"

  - name: SAFFL
    type: str
    label: Safety Population Flag
    derivation:
      flag:
        condition: "TRTSDT IS NOT NULL"
        false_value: "N"
        missing: "N"

  - name: RANDDT
    type: date
    label: Randomization Date
    derivation: DM.RANDDT

  # A working flag, not in the output: ITTFL reads it, so the chain runs
  # RANDDT -> RANDFL -> ITTFL -> POPFL.
  - name: RANDFL
    type: str
    label: Randomized Population Flag
    derivation:
      flag:
        condition: "RANDDT IS NOT NULL"
        false_value: "N"
        missing: "N"

  - name: ITTFL
    type: str
    label: Intent-to-Treat Population Flag
    derivation:
      flag:
        condition: "RANDFL = 'Y'"
        false_value: "N"
        missing: "N"

  - name: POPFL
    type: str
    label: Analysis Population Flag
    derivation:
      flag:
        condition: "SAFFL = 'Y' AND ITTFL = 'Y'"
        false_value: "N"
        missing: "N"

  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: DM.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: DM.USUBJID

  - name: AGE
    type: int
    label: Age
    derivation: DM.AGE

  # 65 itself falls in >=65. With no fallback for a missing AGE, a subject
  # with no age stops the run.
  - name: AGEGR1
    type: str
    label: Pooled Age Group 1
    derivation:
      cut:
        source: AGE
        breaks: [65]
        labels: ["<65", ">=65"]
        right: false

  # 1 for the youngest subject in the study; USUBJID breaks ties.
  - name: AGERNK
    type: int
    label: Pooled Age Group 1 Rank
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID]
          order_by: [AGE, USUBJID]

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
  - row_count:
      min: 7
      max: 7
  - assert:
      id: analysis-population-requires-both-flags
      when: "POPFL = 'Y'"
      require: "SAFFL = 'Y' AND ITTFL = 'Y'"

adam-adsl-new-therapy.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADSL
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
input:
  ADSL_RAW: {path: input/adsl.csv, types: {TRTSDT: date}}
  CM:
    path: input/cm.csv
    types: {CMSTDTC: str, CMSTDTC_IMP: date}
  PR:
    path: input/pr.csv
    types: {PRSTDTC: date}
base: ADSL_RAW

output:
  path: adsl.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, TRTSDT, NACTDT, NACTDY, NACTFL]

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: ADSL_RAW.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: ADSL_RAW.USUBJID

  - name: TRTSDT
    type: date
    label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
    derivation: ADSL_RAW.TRTSDT
    verifications:
      not_missing: {}

  # The first start of an on-treatment medication, and of an on-treatment
  # cancer-related procedure, on or after the treatment start date. A record
  # dated before TRTSDT does not qualify; a record with no start date is
  # ineligible under the range narrowing. MIN skips a missing date, so either
  # is empty when the subject has no dated qualifying record. The medication
  # side reads the completed start date: a year-month CMSTDTC is completed
  # to the 15th of that month in CMSTDTC_IMP, and full dates pass through
  # unchanged, so the example shows the stated completion rule on a partial
  # date (subject 107).
  - name: CMNACTDT
    type: date
    label: First New Anti-Cancer Medication Date
    derivation:
      aggregate:
        filter: "CM.CMCAT = 'ON TREATMENT'"
        between:
          value: TRTSDT
          upper: CMSTDTC_IMP
        expr: "MIN(CM.CMSTDTC_IMP)"

  - name: PRNACTDT
    type: date
    label: First New Anti-Cancer Procedure Date
    derivation:
      aggregate:
        filter: "PR.PRCAT = 'CANCER RELATED' AND PR.PRSCAT = 'ON TREATMENT'"
        between:
          value: TRTSDT
          upper: PRSTDTC
        expr: "MIN(PR.PRSTDTC)"

  # The earlier of the two, skipping an empty one; empty when both are.
  - name: NACTDT
    type: date
    label: New Anti-Cancer Therapy Start Date
    derivation:
      least:
        sources: [CMNACTDT, PRNACTDT]

  # Day 1 is TRTSDT itself.
  - name: NACTDY
    type: int
    label: New Anti-Cancer Therapy Start Relative Day
    derivation:
      study_day:
        date: NACTDT
        reference: TRTSDT

  - name: NACTFL
    type: str
    label: New Anti-Cancer Therapy Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "NACTDT IS NOT NULL"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
  - row_count:
      min: 7
      max: 7
  - all_or_none:
      id: therapy-date-day-and-flag-agree
      columns: [NACTDT, NACTDY, NACTFL]

adam-adsl-treatment.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADSL
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
input:
  DM: input/dm.csv
  EX: {path: input/ex.csv, types: {EXSEQ: int}}
base: DM

output:
  path: adsl.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, TRT01A, TRTSDT, TRTSDTM, TRTSTMF,
    TRTEDT, TRTEDTM, TRTETMF, TRTDURD, SAFFL]

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: DM.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: DM.USUBJID

  # The treatment of the earliest study-drug exposure with a start, ties to
  # the lower EXSEQ. The actual arm fills in when there is none, then
  # NOT TREATED; TRT01A is the result in upper case.
  - name: TRT01RAW
    type: str
    label: First Actual Treatment from Exposure
    derivation:
      source:
        variable: EX.EXTRT
        filter: "EX.EXTRT IN ('VITAMIN D3', 'PLACEBO')
          AND EX.EXSTDTC IS NOT NULL"
        order_by: [EX.EXSTDTC, EX.EXSEQ]
        keep: first

  - name: TRT01SRC
    type: str
    label: Selected Actual Treatment for Period 01
    derivation:
      first_available:
        sources: [TRT01RAW, DM.ACTARM]
        missing: NOT TREATED

  - name: TRT01A
    type: str
    label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
    derivation:
      str_case:
        source: TRT01SRC
        to: upper
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [VITAMIN D3, PLACEBO, NOT TREATED]

  # Earliest start and latest end as collected text. A date alone gets
  # 00:00:00 (start) or 23:59:59 (end), and precision D marks that; a date
  # missing its day gives no date/time at all.
  - name: TRTSDTC
    type: str
    label: Collected Date/Time of First Exposure to Treatment
    derivation:
      aggregate:
        filter: "EX.EXTRT IN ('VITAMIN D3', 'PLACEBO')
          AND EX.EXSTDTC IS NOT NULL"
        expr: "MIN(EX.EXSTDTC)"

  - name: TRTEDTC
    type: str
    label: Collected Date/Time of Last Exposure to Treatment
    derivation:
      aggregate:
        filter: "EX.EXTRT IN ('VITAMIN D3', 'PLACEBO')
          AND EX.EXENDTC IS NOT NULL"
        expr: "MAX(EX.EXENDTC)"

  - name: TRTSDTM
    type: datetime
    label: Datetime of First Exposure to Treatment
    derivation:
      datetime_impute:
        source: TRTSDTC
        time: first
        missing: null
        invalid: null

  - name: TRTSTPR
    type: str
    label: First Exposure Date/Time Collected Precision
    derivation:
      datetime_precision:
        source: TRTSDTM
        missing: null

  - name: TRTSTMF
    type: str
    label: Time of First Exposure Imputation Flag
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "TRTSTPR = 'D'"
          then: {literal: H}
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [H]

  - name: TRTEDTM
    type: datetime
    label: Datetime of Last Exposure to Treatment
    derivation:
      datetime_impute:
        source: TRTEDTC
        time: last
        missing: null
        invalid: null

  - name: TRTETPR
    type: str
    label: Last Exposure Date/Time Collected Precision
    derivation:
      datetime_precision:
        source: TRTEDTM
        missing: null

  - name: TRTETMF
    type: str
    label: Time of Last Exposure Imputation Flag
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "TRTETPR = 'D'"
          then: {literal: H}
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [H]

  - name: TRTSDT
    type: date
    label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
    derivation:
      to_date:
        source: TRTSDTM

  - name: TRTEDT
    type: date
    label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
    derivation:
      to_date:
        source: TRTEDTM

  - name: TRTDURD
    type: int
    label: Total Treatment Duration (Days)
    derivation:
      date_diff:
        start: TRTSDT
        end: TRTEDT
        unit: day
        bounds: inclusive
    verifications:
      range:
        min: 1

  - name: SAFFL
    type: str
    label: Safety Population Flag
    derivation:
      flag:
        condition: "TRTSDT IS NOT NULL"
        false_value: "N"
        missing: "N"
    verifications:
      - not_missing: {}
      - allowed_values:
          values: [Y, N]

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
  - row_count:
      min: 8
      max: 8
  - all_or_none:
      id: treatment-period-completeness
      columns: [TRTSDT, TRTSDTM, TRTEDT, TRTEDTM, TRTDURD]
  - assert:
      id: start-time-imputation-requires-a-start-datetime
      when: "TRTSTMF = 'H'"
      require: "TRTSDTM IS NOT NULL"
  - assert:
      id: end-time-imputation-requires-an-end-datetime
      when: "TRTETMF = 'H'"
      require: "TRTEDTM IS NOT NULL"
  - assert:
      id: placebo-subject-is-in-safety-population
      when: "TRT01A = 'PLACEBO'"
      require: "SAFFL = 'Y'"

adam-adtr-sum.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADTR
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, AVISIT]
input:
  TRVISIT: {path: input/trvisit.csv, types: {ADT: date}}
  TR: {path: input/tr.csv, types: {TRSTRESN: float}}

columns:

    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: TRVISIT.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str

    derivation: TRVISIT.USUBJID

    type: str
    label: Analysis Visit
    derivation: TRVISIT.AVISIT

  # no such record leaves both AVAL and NMEAS empty, not 0, while records
  # with no result at all give NMEAS 0 and still leave AVAL empty.
  - name: AVAL
    type: float

    derivation:

        filter: "TR.TRGRPID = 'TARGET' AND TR.TRTESTCD = 'LDIAM'"

    derivation:

        filter: "TU.TUGRPID = 'TARGET'"
        expr: "COUNT(TU.TULNKID)"

  - name: ANL01FL
    type: str
    label: Analysis Record Flag 01
    derivation:
      flag: "NMEAS = NTARGET"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

verifications:
  - unique:

  - row_count:

      max: 9
  - assert:
      id: measured-lesions-do-not-exceed-the-target-lesions

  - assert:

adam-advs-window-table.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADVS
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, VSSEQ]
input:
  ADVS_RAW: {path: input/advs_raw.csv, types: {ADT: date}}
  AWINDOW:
    path: input/awindow.csv
    types: {AVISITN: int, AWLO: int, AWHI: int, AWTARGET: int}

output:

            AVISITN, AWTARGET, AWTDIFF, ANL01FL]

# The window whose first-to-last study day range, both ends inclusive,
# holds the record's study day, matched on STUDYID (the one output key the
# window table carries). A record with no study day, or a window with no
# last day, gives no match. Records on days 21 and 22 pin the shared edge:
# the upper bound closes Week 2, the lower bound opens Week 4.
intermediates:
  - id: AWIN
    dataset: AWINDOW
    between:
      value: ADY
      lower: AWLO
      upper: AWHI
    no_match: null

columns:

    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: ADVS_RAW.STUDYID

    derivation: ADVS_RAW.PARAMCD

  - name: VSSEQ

    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: ADVS_RAW.VSSEQ

    type: int
    label: Analysis Window Target
    derivation: AWIN.AWTARGET

  - name: AWTDIFF
    type: int
    label: Analysis Window Difference
    derivation:
      compute:
        expr: "ADY - AWTARGET"

    derivation:
      compute:
        expr: "ABS(AWTDIFF)"

  - name: AWRANK

    derivation:

          order_by: [AWTABS, VSSEQ]
          filter: "AVISIT IS NOT NULL"

  - name: ANL01FL
    type: str
    label: Analysis Record Flag 01
    derivation:
      flag: "AWRANK = 1"
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [Y]

verifications:

  - row_count:
      min: 16
      max: 16
  - all_or_none:

  - assert:
      id: analysis-record-has-an-analysis-window

adam-advs-windows.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADVS
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, VSSEQ]
input:
  # SDTM VS: the vital-signs domain as the ADaM programmer receives it.
  # VSDTC is date-only here; VSDY arrives derived upstream, so this
  # benchmark pins windowing, not study-day derivation.
  VS: {path: input/vs.csv, types: {VSDTC: date}}
  # SDTM SV: every planned visit of every subject, including the visits
  # that did not take place, plus the unscheduled visits.
  SV: {path: input/sv.csv, types: {VISITNUM: float}}

output:
  path: advs.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, VSSEQ, VISIT, VISITNUM, ADT, ADY, AVAL,
            AVISIT, AVISITN, ANL01FL]

intermediates:
  # The collected record with the highest sequence number whose study day
  # falls in the planned window the current row names. A record with no
  # study day belongs to no window, so it never counts as coverage.
  - id: WINDOW_COVER
    dataset: SELF
    key: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, AVISIT]
    filter: "SELF.AVISIT IN ('SCREENING', 'BASELINE', 'WEEK 2', 'WEEK 4')"
    order_by: [SELF.VSSEQ]
    keep: last
    no_match: null

  # The collected record with the highest sequence number for the study,
  # subject, and parameter; expected records continue the numbering past
  # it, and a subject with no collected record numbers them from 1.
  - id: PRIOR_MAX
    dataset: SELF
    key: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD]
    order_by: [SELF.VSSEQ]
    keep: last
    no_match: 0

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: VS.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: VS.USUBJID

  # ADaM parameter codes for vital signs mirror the SDTM test codes.
  - name: PARAMCD
    type: str
    label: Parameter Code
    derivation: VS.VSTESTCD

  # The position of an expected record among its study, subject, and
  # parameter's expected records, in planned visit order; missing on
  # collected records. Internal: it numbers the expected records and
  # marks them for the checks below, and never reaches the artifact.
  - name: EXPECTED_ORDER
    type: int
    label: Expected Record Order

  - name: VSSEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: VS.VSSEQ

  - name: VISIT
    type: str
    label: Visit Name
    derivation: VS.VISIT

  - name: VISITNUM
    type: float
    label: Visit Number
    derivation: VS.VISITNUM

  - name: ADT
    type: date
    label: Analysis Date
    derivation: VS.VSDTC

  - name: ADY
    type: int
    label: Analysis Relative Day
    derivation: VS.VSDY

  - name: AVAL
    type: float
    label: Analysis Value
    derivation: VS.VSSTRESN

  # Windows on study day, each including its lower break and excluding its
  # upper one: before 0 SCREENING, 0-1 BASELINE (there is no day 0), 2-21
  # WEEK 2, 22-42 WEEK 4, 43 onward POST-TREATMENT. No study day, no window.
  - name: AVISIT
    type: str
    label: Analysis Visit
    derivation:
      cut:
        source: ADY
        breaks: [0, 2, 22, 43]
        labels: [SCREENING, BASELINE, WEEK 2, WEEK 4, POST-TREATMENT]
        right: false
        missing: null
    verifications:
      allowed_values:
        values: [SCREENING, BASELINE, WEEK 2, WEEK 4, POST-TREATMENT]

  - name: AVISITN
    type: int
    label: Analysis Visit (N)
    derivation:
      mapping:
        source: AVISIT
        dict:
          SCREENING: -1
          BASELINE: 0
          WEEK 2: 2
          WEEK 4: 4
          POST-TREATMENT: 99
        missing: null

  # Within each subject, parameter, and window: earliest study day first,
  # then the lower sequence number. ANL01FL marks rank 1; a record with no
  # window is left out, so it is never flagged.
  - name: AWRANK
    type: int
    label: Analysis Window Rank
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, AVISIT]
          order_by: [ADY, VSSEQ]
          filter: "AVISIT IS NOT NULL"

  # Expected records have no study day, so the flag additionally requires
  # one: an expected record never takes ANL01FL, even when it is the only
  # record in its window.
  - name: ANL01FL
    type: str
    label: Analysis Record Flag 01
    derivation:
      flag: "AWRANK = 1 AND ADY IS NOT NULL"

rows:
  # Every collected record, unchanged.
  - id: collected
    dataset: VS
    derivations:
      EXPECTED_ORDER: {literal: null}

  # One expected record for each planned visit whose window no collected
  # record's study day covers. It carries the planned visit name and
  # number and the window, continues the sequence numbering, and has no
  # date, day, or value.
  - id: expected
    dataset: SV
    filter: "AVISIT IS NOT NULL AND WINDOW_COVER.VSSEQ IS NULL"
    derivations:
      STUDYID: SV.STUDYID
      USUBJID: SV.USUBJID
      PARAMCD: {literal: SYSBP}
      VISIT: SV.VISIT
      VISITNUM: SV.VISITNUM
      ADT: {literal: null}
      ADY: {literal: null}
      AVAL: {literal: null}
      # The window each planned visit is expected in. Unscheduled visits
      # and planned visits after week 4 get no expected record.
      AVISIT:
        mapping:
          source: SV.VISIT
          dict:
            SCREENING: SCREENING
            BASELINE: BASELINE
            WEEK 2: WEEK 2
            WEEK 4: WEEK 4
          missing: null
          unmapped: null
      EXPECTED_ORDER:
        row_number:
          window:
            group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD]
            order_by: [SV.VISITNUM]
      VSSEQ:
        compute:
          expr: "PRIOR_MAX.VSSEQ + EXPECTED_ORDER"

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, VSSEQ]
  # Pins the 19-row fixture: the 14 original collected rows, the new
  # subject's collected baseline record, and the four expected records
  # (one uncovered screening window and one subject missing screening,
  # week 2, and week 4).
  - row_count:
      min: 19
      max: 19
  - all_or_none:
      id: analysis-visit-completeness
      columns: [AVISIT, AVISITN]
  - assert:
      id: analysis-record-has-analysis-visit
      when: "ANL01FL = 'Y'"
      require: "AVISIT IS NOT NULL AND ADY IS NOT NULL"
  - assert:
      id: baseline-window-is-study-day-one
      when: "AVISIT = 'BASELINE'"
      require: "ADY = 1 OR EXPECTED_ORDER IS NOT NULL"
  # An expected record carries a planned window (never the open-ended
  # post-treatment one), has no date, day, or value, and never takes the
  # analysis flag.
  - assert:
      id: expected-record-has-planned-window
      when: "EXPECTED_ORDER IS NOT NULL"
      require: "AVISIT IN ('SCREENING', 'BASELINE', 'WEEK 2', 'WEEK 4')"
  - assert:
      id: expected-record-is-empty
      when: "EXPECTED_ORDER IS NOT NULL"
      require: "ADT IS NULL AND ADY IS NULL AND AVAL IS NULL"
  - assert:
      id: expected-record-never-flagged
      when: "EXPECTED_ORDER IS NOT NULL"
      require: "ANL01FL IS NULL"
  # Every collected measurement has a value.
  - assert:
      id: collected-record-has-value
      when: "EXPECTED_ORDER IS NULL"
      require: "AVAL IS NOT NULL"

occurrences.payload: AWRANK = 1 AND ADY IS NOT NULL

sdtm-lb-last-observation-before-exposure.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: LB
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ]
input:
  ODM: input/odm.csv
  DM:
    path: input/dm.csv
    types: {RFSTDTC: date}
  LB_MAPPING: input/lb_mapping.csv
base: ODM

output:
  path: lb.csv
  columns: [DOMAIN, STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ, LBTESTCD, LBSPEC, LBORRES,
            LBDTC, LBSTAT, LBLOBXFL]

intermediates:
  - id: LB_MAP
    dataset: LB_MAPPING
    key: {ItemOID: ODM.ItemOID}
    no_match: null

columns:
  - name: DOMAIN
    type: str
    label: Domain Abbreviation
    derivation: {literal: LB}

  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: ODM.StudyOID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: ODM.SubjectKey

  - name: LBSEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: ODM.ItemGroupRepeatKey
    verifications:
      not_missing: {}

  - name: LBTESTCD
    type: str
    label: Lab Test or Examination Short Name

  - name: LBSPEC
    type: str
    label: Specimen Material Type

  - name: LBORRES
    type: str
    label: Result or Finding in Original Units

  # The date and status items of the same item group occurrence as the
  # result; missing when that occurrence has none.
  - name: LBDTC
    type: date
    label: Date/Time of Specimen Collection
    derivation: {odm: ODM.IT.LB.LBDTC}

  - name: LBSTAT
    type: str
    label: Completion Status
    derivation: {odm: ODM.IT.LB.LBSTAT}

  - name: RFSTDTC
    type: date
    label: Subject Reference Start Date/Time
    derivation: DM.RFSTDTC

  # Rank each record against the other results for the same subject,
  # test, and specimen. Only records with a result, collected on or
  # before the reference start date (or with no reference start at
  # all), are ranked; the latest collection date wins, with the
  # sequence number breaking ties.
  - name: LOBXRNK
    type: int
    label: Last Observation Before Exposure Rank
    derivation:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBTESTCD, LBSPEC]
          order_by:
            - {variable: LBDTC, direction: desc}
            - {variable: LBSEQ, direction: desc}
          filter: >-
            LBORRES IS NOT NULL AND (RFSTDTC IS NULL OR LBDTC <= RFSTDTC)

  - name: LBLOBXFL
    type: str
    label: Last Observation Before Exposure Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "LOBXRNK = 1"

# One record per result item of each item group occurrence. The date and
# status items are not in the dictionary, so their LBTESTCD is missing and
# the filter drops them; they are read back onto the result record below.
rows:
  - id: lb_result
    dataset: ODM
    group_by: [ODM.StudyOID, ODM.SubjectKey, ODM.StudyEventOID, ODM.FormOID,
               ODM.ItemGroupOID, ODM.ItemGroupRepeatKey, ODM.ItemOID]
    filter: "LBTESTCD IS NOT NULL"
    derivations:
      LBTESTCD: LB_MAP.LBTESTCD
      LBSPEC: LB_MAP.LBSPEC
      LBORRES:
        aggregate:
          expr: "ONLY(ODM.Value)"

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 14
      max: 14
  - assert:
      id: flagged-record-has-a-result
      when: "LBLOBXFL = 'Y'"
      require: "LBORRES IS NOT NULL"
  - assert:
      id: flagged-record-is-done
      when: "LBLOBXFL = 'Y'"
      require: "LBSTAT IS NULL"
